steps.en: Owners whose 3rd letter has gone out are picked for an electronic reminder
steps.id: Pemilik yang letter ke-3 sudah diproses dipilih untuk reminder elektronik
steps.why_en: The electronic reminder job is switched off in production settings.
steps.why_id: Job reminder elektronik dimatikan di pengaturan produksi.

steps.en: The owner's most recent mobile number is looked up and stored
steps.id: Nomor mobile terbaru pemilik dicari dan disimpan
steps.why_en: The lookup is switched off in production settings; the stored old number is used.
steps.why_id: Pencarian dimatikan di pengaturan produksi; nomor lama di database yang dipakai.

steps.en: The company's most recent email address is looked up and stored
steps.id: Alamat email terbaru company dicari dan disimpan
steps.why_en: The lookup is switched off in production settings; the stored old email is used.
steps.why_id: Pencarian dimatikan di pengaturan produksi; email lama di database yang dipakai.

steps.en: Only owners with a usable contact get an electronic reminder
steps.id: Hanya pemilik dengan kontak yang bisa dipakai yang dapat reminder elektronik
steps.why_en: The rule exists but sits in the job that is switched off in production.
steps.why_id: Aturan ada, tetapi berada di job yang dimatikan di produksi.
